_provenance.authored_from: OpenAI published error schema. 503 is documented for an overloaded engine and is retryable. It replaces the vendor-specific 529 the previous fixture set carried.
_provenance.notes: Classified as provider_error, exactly like a 500. Kept as its own fixture because it is the status a capacity problem arrives as, and a classifier only ever exercised against 500 would be untested against the failure the platform is most likely to meet at peak.

error.message: The engine is currently overloaded, please try again later.
